entries.name: Atelier Editorial
entries.description: Gamma 5-inspired culinary and cultural editorial direction for restaurants, travel, craft and exhibitions. Burgundy/cream serif hierarchy, one photographic hero, ingredient/method pages and complete food, object and cutout prompts. Uses yrkie-atelier.

entries.name: Aurora Product
entries.description: Digital-product concepts, creative technology and forward-looking product narratives. Distinguish concept, shipped capability and measured result. Uses yrkie-aurora. Includes density-aware native compositions and complete image prompts.

entries.name: Blueprint Lab
entries.description: Engineering explanations, research reviews, system choices and technical planning. Communicate explicit relationships rather than decorative complexity. Uses yrkie-blueprint. Includes density-aware native compositions and complete image prompts.

entries.name: Botanical Journal
entries.description: Field research, garden projects, ecology education and plant-based product stories. Use the visual language of observation; green styling does not prove sustainability. Uses yrkie-botanical. Includes density-aware native compositions and complete image prompts.

entries.name: Citrus Paper
entries.description: Warm learning, community and practical product stories with shallow cream, green and coral paper sculpture. Includes five native page compositions and four precise image prompts. Uses yrkie-citrus.

entries.name: Coastal Escape
entries.description: Gamma 5-inspired photographic direction for travel, retreats and hospitality. Teal water, limestone and sand, short handwritten headings, readable itineraries and full-background/portrait/detail prompts with planned negative space. Uses yrkie-coast.

entries.name: Cobalt Current
entries.description: Culture programs, bold launches, events and energetic public-facing information. Make the structure as confident as the palette. Uses yrkie-cobalt. Includes density-aware native compositions and complete image prompts.

entries.name: Copper Archive
entries.description: Heritage, institutional history, collections, archives and industrial craft. Convey depth through evidence and chronology rather than fake aging. Uses yrkie-copper. Includes density-aware native compositions and complete image prompts.

entries.name: Ink & Vermilion
entries.description: Contemporary editorial, object and material stories with warm paper, ink and selective vermilion. Includes five native page compositions and four precise image prompts. Uses yrkie-vermilion.

entries.name: Ledger Investigation
entries.description: Gamma 5-inspired archival editorial direction for investigative reports, financial reviews and evidence-led stories. Paper-and-ink display hierarchy, documentary image direction, native evidence pages and composition-specific image prompts. Uses yrkie-ledger.

entries.name: MckinseyDesignSkill
entries.description: Executive strategy, board reviews, operating performance, business cases and transformation decisions. Independent DOE adaptation of consulting exhibits; uses conclusion-led arguments and native evidence pages.

entries.name: Noir Luxe
entries.description: Premium hospitality, considered product launches, craftsmanship and private-client presentations. The effect is selective attention, not glitter or a claim that something is exclusive. Uses yrkie-noir. Includes density-aware native compositions and complete image prompts.

entries.name: Obsidian Prism
entries.description: Precise product and creative-technology stories with neutral black surfaces and restrained physical iridescence. Includes five native page compositions and four precise image prompts. Uses yrkie-obsidian.

entries.name: Rose Gallery
entries.description: Exhibitions, visual portfolios, fashion culture and intimate editorial storytelling. Use gallery restraint rather than romantic decoration. Uses yrkie-rose. Includes density-aware native compositions and complete image prompts.

entries.name: Sage Wellness
entries.description: Restorative spaces, everyday wellbeing education, quiet hospitality and community care. A calm visual tone must not imply medical efficacy. Uses yrkie-sage. Includes density-aware native compositions and complete image prompts.

entries.name: Sunburst Campaign
entries.description: Gamma 5-inspired playful direction for launches, community campaigns and celebrations. Rounded orange display type, cream/pink/yellow accents, large petal motifs, human photography and image prompts with deliberate text-safe regions. Uses yrkie-sunburst.

entries.name: Swiss Signal
entries.description: Announcements, public information, operating reviews and clear decision documents. This is an original grid-led direction, not a reproduction of a named designer or poster. Uses yrkie-swiss. Includes density-aware native compositions and complete image prompts.

entries.name: Terracotta Studio
entries.description: Architecture, interiors, ceramics, maker portfolios and material-led cultural stories. Warmth should come from texture and generous proportions, not lifestyle cliches. Uses yrkie-terracotta. Includes density-aware native compositions and complete image prompts.
